# The winter coat pocket test

Sewed a larger pocket into the coat and wore it on the bicycle before finishing the lining. The keys hit my knee on every pedal stroke. A perfect flat pattern would not have told me that. [[Maintenance]]: test the movement that matters while the seams are still easy to reopen. Unpicking ten stitches now is cheaper than declaring the finished object inconvenient.
